projects.title: Palisade Park Chipotle Mexican Grill
projects.description: A Final Plat and Site Development Plan/Urban Renewal Site Plan (SDP/URSP) application from Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. for a freestanding restaurant on a 1.03-acre property at 700 W 168th Place, part of Palisade Park Filing No. 1 Replat G, Lot 1. The Final Plat creates two lots, with the restaurant on the eastern lot; the applicant requested a deviation from the Broomfield Municipal Code to exceed the maximum permitted parking spaces. Heard by City Council as Resolution No. 2026-107 and by the Broomfield Urban Renewal Authority (BURA) as its companion Resolution No. 2026-108-UR.
